physical.scope: Six nominal command cases, deterministic fresh simulators. No policy update. Compare a bounded 32-action plan against the same frozen actor actions; not a full continuous-control acceptance test.

invalid_warm_probe_reason: Rejected by unperturbed replay control: score delta 0.004486978054046631 > 0.001. Do not use its treatment contrasts.

frozen_expert_physical_gate.scope: Deterministic simulation only; no filtering failed environments; mean command response is distinct from instantaneous RMSE.

notes: num_envs=512 in legacy reused-run CLI/provenance is an unused collection argument. Narrow training data come from original 64-environment window8-control recordings, identified by hashes. Rich recordings use 512 environments.
32-step fit has 128 updates versus 512 for 8-step fits, at the same batch512 and 2097152 dynamics transition predictions. Comparisons include this optimizer-step difference.
